job: Sign in with a password, a provider or an emailed code, in one centred card with nothing beside it.
purpose: A quiet front door: the brand, one card (providers, email and password, or a sign-in link with its code) and a legal footer on a dot grid. Choose it when the product has nothing to say beside the form. A wrong password, a lock after too many tries and an unreachable service each say what happened and what to do next.
useWhen: The sign-in should be one centred card, for an app, a portal or an embedded login.

avoidWhen.when: The page should also say what the product does, or offer sign-up in place.
The person arrives from a link and answers one question without signing in.

states.name: sign in
states.how: the default: social buttons, email and password, an email-link option

states.name: link sent
states.how: ?state=sent: the one-time code in fd-otp, Resend, Use a different email

states.name: locked
states.how: ?state=locked: a warning callout, fields and Sign in disabled; the email link still works

states.name: error
states.how: ?state=error: a danger callout with Try again; nothing the person typed is lost
